current_activity: division seizes the high ground south of Houffalize and meets the 2d Armored Division
notes: Event date: 16 January 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 2 p. 42-43: on the 16th the 11th Armored Division seized the high ground south of Houffalize and a patrol met a patrol of the 2d Armored Division of VII Corps south-west of the town). Event definition: the division reaches the Houffalize heights and makes the link-up of the two attacking forces; Houffalize is the objective of the day, not a headquarters. Relationship: VIII Corps unspecified_subordination (from 15 Jan 45 to 11 Mar 45, CMH table); Third Army assigned (from 23 Dec 44, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 13 Dec 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: the high ground south of Houffalize; the town centre stands for it. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Houffalize. Event support: moderate (single Green Book passage; the CMH table lists VIII Corps from 15 January). Location support: moderate (named place; the heights lie a few kilometres from the town centre).
